title: VanEck launches diversified ETF combining stocks, bonds and Bitcoin exposure
summary: VanEck launches diversified ETF combining stocks, bonds and Bitcoin exposure
briefing: VanEck’s new Wealth Builder ETF targets a 2% Bitcoin allocation, with a permitted range of 1% to 5%, gaining exposure through a spot Bitcoin ETP.

summary: Intel, IBM, Oracle and IonQ latest to object to OKX-ICE tokenized stocks
briefing: More than 40% of the companies initially proposed to have their stocks listed in tokenized form have asked to opt-out.

summary: Quantum fears already limiting Bitcoin’s growth, Stacks founder says
briefing: Speaking on Cointelegraph’s Chain Reaction podcast, Muneeb Ali warned that uncertainty over Bitcoin’s quantum security could deter institutional investors.

summary: Ripple, Robinhood expand partnership to bring RLUSD to retail and institutional markets
briefing: Ripple also expanded its collaboration with BNY on digital asset custody and partnered with C2FO to bring trade finance settlement onto the XRP Ledger.

summary: CFTC sues Utah to block action against prediction markets
briefing: The US state filed a lawsuit against Kalshi last week, seeking to recover up to $60 million in profits related to event contracts on prediction markets.

summary: Majority of Americans want candidates who support US-based financial technology: Poll

summary: Janus Henderson, Centrifuge launch tokenized Nasdaq-100 fund on Stellar
briefing: The blockchain-based fund offers eligible non-US investors exposure to the Nasdaq-100 as Janus Henderson expands its institutional tokenization business.

title: China's Stock Market Has Lost $2.4 Trillion as Investors Doubt Its AI Boom Will Ever Pay Off
summary: China's Stock Market Has Lost $2.4 Trillion as Investors Doubt Its AI Boom Will Ever Pay Off
briefing: Stocks on China's mainland have shed about $2.4 trillion since May as investors doubt AI companies can turn a profit, while U.S. restrictions and high U.S. interest rates add pressure.

summary: Robinhood Misses Q3 Earnings as Crypto Revenue Rises and Prediction Market Bets Grow
briefing: Robinhood posted record revenue of $1.42 billion but earned $0.51 per share, short of the $0.55 expected, as bets on sports and elections grew to $173 million and crypto edged up.

summary: Robinhood Taps Ripple's Stablecoin, Treasury Software and Trading Loans
briefing: Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin is live on Robinhood Chain and Bitstamp, and heads to the Robinhood app later this year as the companies deepen ties in treasury and institutional trading.

summary: Anchorage Positions Itself as Custody Backbone of US-Mexico Stablecoin Corridor
briefing: An expanded deal with Bitso puts Anchorage Digital Bank’s custody beneath both sides of the US-Mexico remittance route.

title: AI Agents Are Creating a New Layer of Cybersecurity Spending
summary: AI Agents Are Creating a New Layer of Cybersecurity Spending
briefing: Akamai launched a locked box for AI agents on Tuesday. It joins Palo Alto, Cisco, CrowdStrike, Okta and Zscaler in selling protection for software that now acts on its own.

title: Intel, Oracle, IBM Join Objections to OKX-ICE Tokenized Stock Venue, Bringing Total to 26
summary: Intel, Oracle, IBM Join Objections to OKX-ICE Tokenized Stock Venue, Bringing Total to 26
briefing: Intel, Oracle, IBM, and IonQ became the latest companies to object to trading of their shares on the planned OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue, bringing the total to 26.

title: Bitcoin Wallet Maker Keystone Pulls Devices as Stolen Key Opens Door to Fakes
summary: Bitcoin Wallet Maker Keystone Pulls Devices as Stolen Key Opens Door to Fakes
briefing: Attackers obtained the factory key that proves Keystone's hardware wallets are genuine, and 25,964 buyer records were affected. The company says recovery phrases and private keys were not involved.

summary: Circle Pushes Deeper Into Latin America With USDC Settlement in Colombia
briefing: A collaboration with payments-tech firm ACI Worldwide will pilot folding USDC settlement into Colombia’s instant-payments network.
